Full-depth fan-out: family "Governance protocols and the ProjectCentral contract". Scene ids derive from the bound record paths; glyph terms are the bound records' own heading words. Presentation mappings are declared craft. Not corpus-complete claims beyond the frozen inventory: see the product receipt fulldepth-receipt-2026-09-21.md for exclusions and census-delta notes.

Moves: the governance shelf is a guard arc — layered sources, content protocol, retrieval treatment, project context protocol, and the ProjectCentral contract all hold (normative sources keep their standing); flow gathers (the yaml flows received), NOW/DAY emerges (the moving horizon), the documentation index walks (by role, not alphabet), and the chosen root recognition marks (a read-only native act — the ground recognised; 3D: z is the recognition's depth — the chosen path nearest, the recognised ground deepest).

3D: the member's depth is continuity layers — z is Central's own depth relation: the living surface nearest, the carried ground deepest (laminated; depthPerspective on). Pointers: guard=sources hold their standing, gather=continuity gathers the field (Central holds by attraction), vortex=correction turns the ground, rupture=recovery from loss, settle=continuity at rest. Automation: one LFO per member — the carried ground breathes. Sequences walk each record's own heading words.
